nodes.label: 2026-09-27 verification snapshot
nodes.description: 2026-09-27: 54 tests passed (23 simulation/IO, 31 testnet), frontend build and both browser suites passed. Independent RPC proof verifies all ten successful receipts: four direct-Arc and six crosschain. Both invoices reconciled; pending burn and approval/converted states survived restarts without duplicate submission. Server .mjs remains outside frontend typecheck.

nodes.label: Testnet implementation plan completed
nodes.description: All five plan tasks evidence-backed complete for testnet prototype: SDK/funding, tested model/store/recovery, guarded API, tested separate UI, and both live routes. Arc 1 USDC→0.822060 EURC and crosschain 1 USDC burn→1 USDC mint→0.822252 EURC paid/reconciled. Ten receipts independently verified; 54 tests, build, browser checks and reviews passed. Production and full fault coverage remain outside proven scope.

nodes.label: Request guards
nodes.description: Allowed Host/Origin and JSON mutation token validation.

nodes.label: Chain integration
nodes.description: Allowlisted clients, corrected viem factories, quote submission prohibition, approval classification, CCTP immutable attestation/sourceTxHash checks and retry, swap receipt gates, payouts and receipts.

nodes.label: Remaining recovery coverage boundary
nodes.description: Approval-only recovery, converted state, and confirmed CCTP burn during approximately 24-minute attestation wait survived actual server restarts. Original burn used once; both proofs reconciled. Reverted-stage retries use mocked RPC and fresh receipt checks. Full network fault/reversion coverage and SDK atomic batch recovery remain unestablished; reviewed live path is sequential.

nodes.label: Strict obligation CSV intake
nodes.description: Atomic validation; unique case-insensitive references; USDC only, six decimals, 500 rows, 1 MB; formula-safe simulation exports.

nodes.label: Distinct persisted testnet stages
nodes.description: Base created→bridging→funded; Arc starts funded; quoted→swapping→converted→paying→paid→reconciled. Recover bridging/swapping/paying only. Explicit retry requires freshly confirmed reverted bridge stage; retrying mint preserves successful burn. Only paid reconciles; quote expires in 60 seconds.

nodes.label: CCTP V2 immutable attestation validation
nodes.description: Bind response sourceTxHash to recorded burn; match immutable message bytes including hooks; validate nonzero matching nonce, sufficient finality and bounded fee. Circle populates nonce/finality/fee/expiration offchain, so full-message equality is wrong. Indexing 404 is a recoverable pending condition; final live attestation and mint verified.
nodes.rationale: Preserve original successful burn during indexing/attestation waits while rejecting an altered completed message.

nodes.label: Testnet payments workspace
nodes.description: Both direct-Arc and Base Sepolia CCTP→Arc→swap→recipient payment→reconciliation verified onchain. Separate UI, local signer/API and disk records. Two proof payments reconciled with ten independently verified receipts; prototype is not production ready.

nodes.label: Base → CCTP → Arc → swap → EURC payout
nodes.description: Both routes verified: direct Arc skips CCTP; crosschain proof used one 1-USDC Base burn, Circle attestation, one 1-USDC Arc mint, USDC/EURC conversion and exact recipient transfer before reconciliation. No second burn; distinct transactions are not one atomic crosschain payment.
nodes.norm_label: base → cctp → arc → swap → eurc payout

nodes.label: CCTP-PROOF-001 verified and reconciled
nodes.description: CCTP-PROOF-001 reconciled: one 1-USDC Base burn at block 47360897 (0x1b5e955ed53db1d408fa2a85cb703f0bc3e92d8c5e1c390b6ef749d4c26021ee), one 1-USDC Arc mint, 0.822252 EURC converted and paid above 0.813463 minimum. All six receipts verified. Original burn survived restarts and approximately 24-minute attestation wait without duplication. Final balances: 18.963038 Arc USDC, 0 Arc EURC, 19 Base USDC, 0.000998997742905892 Base ETH.

nodes.label: Testnet browser checks
nodes.description: Checks existing reconciled records, rejected duplicate payout and missing-token request, CSV export, reload/persistence and desktop/mobile layout; does not approve new transfers.

nodes.label: Simulation workspace
nodes.description: Complete synthetic browser-local demo; no chain proof. Fixed 0.915000 EURC/USDC, 0.25 USDC fee, 60-second quotes.

nodes.label: Payment service
nodes.description: Creation, duplicate references, guarded stage transitions, operation serialization, recovery and explicit reverted-stage retry.

nodes.label: Exact EURC invoice settlement missing
nodes.description: Current obligation fixes USDC input and pays variable EURC output; exact euro invoices need target EURC, maximum source spend, fees and under/overpayment rules.

nodes.label: Clearline payment operations desk
nodes.description: Current scope: invoice/reference, funding, approved conversion, recipient payment, reconciliation and export; StableFX is optional future integration.

nodes.label: Testnet implementation ledger
nodes.description: Dated history preserves initial 36-test blocker, resolved Arc SDK/journal issues, CCTP indexing/attestation wait and five failing-then-passing message/sourceTxHash regressions. Final evidence: 54 tests pass, both routes reconciled and all ten receipts independently verified. Original CCTP burn survived restarts and approximately 24-minute attestation wait with no duplicate burn.

nodes.label: Exclude private runtime state and secrets
nodes.description: Do not index .clearline-testnet, read wallet.json or expose keys, raw signed bytes, credentials or VITE secrets in UI, logs, exports, docs or graphs.
nodes.norm_label: exclude private runtime state and secrets
nodes.rationale: Generated navigation must not leak signer secrets or transaction journal material.

nodes.label: Browser persistence boundary
nodes.description: Editable local storage is not confidential, shared, immutable or transactional; corrupted data is preserved for backup with explicit reset; stale tabs detected.

nodes.label: Simulation domain
nodes.description: Exact money, seed state, pure transitions and ledger.

nodes.label: Receipt-proven reverted CCTP retry
nodes.description: Explicit retry requires fresh verification of the current reverted bridge receipt, preserves prior hashes and advances that stage attempt; retrying mint never repeats a successful burn. Mocked RPC regression coverage; no live reverted bridge proof.
nodes.rationale: A confirmed revert permits a controlled new attempt; timeout or pending attestation alone does not authorize another transfer.

nodes.label: Testnet API lifecycle
nodes.description: GET snapshot/session token; POST creation, refresh and bridge/quote/swap/pay/recover/retry/reconcile actions. Actions run asynchronously; UI polls every 2.5 seconds. Public serialization strips signed bytes.

nodes.label: Bind attestation to original source transaction
nodes.description: Identical source burns can have identical immutable message bytes. Recovery requires Circle sourceTxHash to match the recorded original burn. Wrong-hash regression failed before fix; suite now passes 54/54.
nodes.norm_label: bind attestation to original source transaction
nodes.rationale: Immutable-byte comparison alone cannot distinguish otherwise identical burns; source transaction binding prevents accepting another burn's attestation.

nodes.label: Loopback signer request safeguards
nodes.description: Keep Host, Origin and session-token checks with loopback binding.
nodes.rationale: These protect a local development signer but are not production identity/authentication.

nodes.label: Approval classification and restart recovery
nodes.description: Live USDC increaseAllowance was initially mislabeled swap:1. Exact receipt checks blocked false conversion. Added selector classification and journal intent matching, recovered legacy record as swap_approve:1 after restart with same hash and no rebroadcast. Already-converted state also survived restart.

nodes.label: Dedicated local test-only signer
nodes.description: Locally generated test wallet used by local Node server; production custody outside scope.
nodes.rationale: Provides runnable prototype without browser wallet setup; keys remain server-side.

nodes.label: Local API server
nodes.description: Loopback HTTP, process lock, asynchronous actions and balance cache.

nodes.label: Small testnet payment limits
nodes.description: More than zero and at most 100 USDC; Base bridge currently requires more than 0.01 USDC. Fee cap is code configuration, not universal protocol guarantee.

nodes.label: React entry
nodes.description: Mounts React and imports fonts/styles.

nodes.label: Simulation workspace hook
nodes.description: Mutation/persistence boundary including damaged or stale storage.

nodes.label: CSV boundary
nodes.description: Obligation parsing, ledger export and downloads.

nodes.label: Testnet network allowlist
nodes.description: Only Arc Testnet 5042002 and Base Sepolia 84532; CCTP domain IDs are separate.
nodes.rationale: Reject mainnet and preserve chain/RPC validation while fixing adapter identifiers.

nodes.label: Reconciliation changes accounting only
nodes.description: Only paid testnet payments can reconcile; reconciliation does not move funds.
nodes.rationale: A matched record must not trigger another debit or substitute for beneficiary receipt proof.

nodes.label: Testnet acceptance requirements
nodes.description: Original acceptance requirements: validation, stage/persistence/replay/receipt/security tests, frontend build, browser flow, and precise real testnet hashes/outcomes when access permits. Simulation is not chain proof. Current acceptance evidence is maintained separately in PROJECT_MAP.

nodes.label: Historical StableFX settlement operations selection
nodes.description: Original highest-ranked opportunity: 3.80/5 analyst score, operations software for payment providers adopting institutional StableFX.
nodes.rationale: Operational integration, exceptions and reconciled records were intended differentiators; score is not observed product-market fit.

nodes.label: Simulation exactly-once recovery
nodes.description: Pending/unknown reserves source debit; later deterministic status check credits EURC once. Provider recovery must instead verify real status.

nodes.label: Persist signature and hash before broadcast
nodes.description: Persist original signature/hash before broadcast. Recover original receipt or replay identical signed bytes; reused journal step must match destination, calldata and value. Recognize approve and increaseAllowance. Never erase journal to retry; timeout alone cannot authorize another transfer.
nodes.norm_label: persist signature and hash before broadcast
nodes.rationale: Timeout or restart does not authorize duplicate transfers; all SDK submission paths still need live verification.

nodes.label: Durable transaction journal
nodes.description: Persist signature/hash before broadcast; replay identical bytes; reused steps must match original destination, calldata and value.

nodes.label: Testnet UI
nodes.description: Polls local API; wallet balances, actions, receipts and testnet export.

nodes.label: Independent public receipt verifier
nodes.description: Read-only scripts/verify-testnet.mjs verifies completed payment receipts through public RPC and emits proof JSON. No wallet loading or transaction submission.

nodes.label: ARC-PROOF-001 verified and reconciled
nodes.description: Reconciled Arc-only proof: 1 USDC input, 0.813844 EURC minimum, 0.822060 EURC actual and exact payout. All four recorded receipts independently verified in docs/TESTNET_PROOF.json. Arc balance 18.982572 USDC after total source debit 1.017428 including transaction/provider fees. Earlier approval-only attempt recovered across restart without rebroadcast; its hash retained. Direct-Arc funded label still does not establish sufficient balance.

nodes.label: Resolved viem adapter boundary mismatch
nodes.description: Resolved: both viem factories use chain.id, matching the installed adapter. Regression tests retain mainnet and RPC mismatch rejection; quote adapters cannot submit. The former chain.chainId guard blocked initial wallet initialization.

nodes.label: Resolved conversion and approval receipt gates
nodes.description: Resolved: conversion requires verified output/minimum and successful swap receipt; SDK approval receipts update the journal; payout rechecks conversion. Earlier null-result conversion risk reproduced by tests and fixed.
nodes.norm_label: resolved conversion and approval receipt gates

nodes.label: Separate EURC recipient payout
nodes.description: Separate exact ERC-20 payouts verified: 0.822060 EURC for direct proof and 0.822252 EURC for crosschain proof, both to local test recipient and reconciled. Paid requires expected successful receipt and exact token/sender/recipient/amount log; payout revalidates conversion.

nodes.label: Production pilot requirements remain
nodes.description: Shared database/idempotency, custody and wallet policy, roles/approvals, monitoring, durable accounting and operational validation are not implemented.

nodes.label: Simulation/testnet data separation
nodes.description: Simulation localStorage and testnet disk records and exports remain separate.
nodes.rationale: Synthetic outcomes must not be confused with chain evidence.

nodes.label: Application navigation
nodes.description: Simulation views and separate testnet entry.

nodes.label: Integer money and shared Arc USDC balance
nodes.description: Six-decimal integer strings and bigint; native Arc USDC 18 decimals and ERC-20 6 decimals represent the same balance.
nodes.norm_label: integer money and shared arc usdc balance
nodes.rationale: Avoid floating-point ledger errors and double-counting the native and ERC-20 interfaces.

nodes.label: Private disk persistence
nodes.description: Test wallet generation; mode-restricted fsynced temporary-file/rename records.

nodes.label: Circle Swap Kit conversion
nodes.description: USDC/EURC estimate/swap via installed viem adapter. Direct proof converted 1 USDC to 0.822060 EURC (minimum 0.813844); crosschain proof converted 1 USDC to 0.822252 EURC (minimum 0.813463). Fixed factory/approval classification; not a direct Uniswap SDK integration or identified pool proof.

nodes.label: Simulation storage validation
nodes.description: Validates saved browser workspace.

nodes.label: Payment model
nodes.description: Validation, action guards, token log parsing, exact payout proof and public serialization.

nodes.label: CCTP USDC funding
nodes.description: Verified direct CCTP approval/burn, Circle attestation and Arc mint: exactly 1 USDC burned once and minted once. Standard attestation took about 24 minutes, executed finality 2000, zero CCTP token fee for this transfer. Immutable-message/nonce/finality/fee checks and sourceTxHash binding passed live recovery. Base domain 6/Arc 26; configured fee cap 0.01 USDC. Reverted-stage retries remain mocked-RPC regression evidence.

nodes.label: Public receipt evidence for both completed routes
nodes.description: docs/TESTNET_PROOF.json independently verifies all ten successful receipts: four direct Arc, six CCTP route. Direct swap 0x9d84d0576c190534b46f2b256f9ad883e3faab28584bd809e2c74f209083183b; direct payout 0xb557b9a922edfd1ca267246bba9083083399a4d43bee010f22e64d33750bb30a. Crosschain burn 0x1b5e955ed53db1d408fa2a85cb703f0bc3e92d8c5e1c390b6ef749d4c26021ee; mint 0x923c36c1350cc7f5ad9c37d286ac18164cc9fd1ab8dd397faca09f95e456bc17; swap 0x651c524597c6eb10dbb4a33bd0cdf39668d62ee28b430aca44875b791983c89a; payout 0xd205320e3092980f42dfe5dfb884fccd3468db3084b9f99883237d9f189f50d3. Both payments reconciled. Test-pool execution is not market FX.
nodes.norm_label: public receipt evidence for both completed routes

nodes.label: Just-in-time multicurrency treasury funding
nodes.description: Historical rank 2, 3.55/5; validate with an existing treasury and realistic redemption constraints.

nodes.label: Market-maker inventory and obligation controls
nodes.description: Historical rank 3, 3.40/5; requires an existing StableFX maker design partner.

nodes.label: Multicurrency merchant-acquirer settlement
nodes.description: Historical rank 4, 2.75/5; partner-led approach with acquirer distribution and compliance infrastructure.

nodes.label: Multicurrency tokenized-fund subscriptions
nodes.description: Historical rank 5, 2.70/5; issuer access, eligibility and ownership records are dependencies.

nodes.label: Confidential payroll watchlist
nodes.description: Historical unscored sixth option; conditional on usable native privacy, not a validated available opportunity.

nodes.label: Historical deterministic settlement design
nodes.description: Browser-only React/TypeScript app with synthetic balances, local persistence and no signing.
nodes.rationale: Immediately usable without credentials while clearly stating the simulation boundary.

nodes.label: Simulator browser checks
nodes.description: Covers simulator workflows only.

nodes.label: Historical simulator browser smoke
nodes.description: Nine groups passed, browser errors empty, 375px viewport verified; this proves only simulator workflows, not testnet execution.
